overview.text: Axion Estin means It Is Truly Meet. The named Athonite icon is associated with the Church’s hymn to the Mother of God and a traditional encounter with the Archangel Gabriel.

blocks.text: The reproduced icon depicts Mary holding Christ within a decorated metal covering. The file identifies the named Axion Estin icon at Karyes on Mount Athos. Its catalogue’s traditional early dating is retained as a source claim.

blocks.text: The OCA relates that a visiting monk joins a disciple in prayer and sings the hymn’s unfamiliar opening before the older More Honorable than the Cherubim. He writes the words on a roof tile and is revealed as Gabriel. The icon is then brought to the cathedral at Karyes. These are the published miracle tradition.
